cells.date: Śaka 1634, Nandana, Dakshināyana, Grishma, Ashadha, ba. amavasya. Tuesday. Pushya.
cells.remarks: States that Muttuvīraṇavāthadēva, son of Kaṭṭadēva, who was the elder brother of the king and was residing at Uttarakōśamaṅgai, remitted half of the revenue from the villages Āykkudi and Sundaravūr which belonged to Tiruvēṅkaṭanāthayya, son of Tirumalai-nātha-Tiruvēṅkaṭāchārya for the expenses of feeding in the temple of Aḷagar and for digging a tank between the temple and Appan-Tirupati. The king calls him-self the ‘Lord of Tēvāṇagar (Rāmēśvaram)’ and had the ‘Hanu-mān-banner’.

Registers the varshādāna-patrika given by the 102 nagaras of Gottimukkala for the maintenance of worship and lamps in the temple of Uttanēśvara at the village, and specifies the rates of tolls to be levied upon various articles of merchandise passing through the ghat (at that place).

cells.location: Bikkavolu
cells.place: On one side of the doorway leading to the central shrine of the Gōlingēśvara temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers grant of land to the temple of Baṇyēśvara-Mahādēva. Mentions Padmāvati who received (the land) as bhōkabhartṛi.

cells.location: Bikkavolu †
cells.place: On two stones built into the floor of the mosque in the same village (as Gōlingēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to record gift of sheep, evidently for a lamp. Mentions Śakaṭamāṇi-nīḍu.

cells.location: Duvva
cells.place: On a pillar in the man-ḍapa in front of the central shrine of the Gōpālasvāmin temple in the village.
cells.remarks: States that 6 puṭti of land was the inam given to the Vaiknānasa Uddandārayani Ramānujasvāmi for conducting the daily worship of the gods Gopalasvāmin, Kéśavaraya, Pallakéśvara and Hanuān at Duvva, the expenses for other services being met by the villagers and by the local officials.

cells.location: Duvva †
cells.place: On the pillar of Gōpālasvāmin †
cells.date: Śaka 1570, Sarvadhari, Phalguna, śu. 10, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 15: Śaka 1570, Sarvadhāri, Phālguna, śu. 10, Monday = A.D. 1649, February 12, Monday; 16.]
cells.remarks: States that Mallināḍu, Gaṅgaṇa and Veṅkaṭādri, sons of Vipparti Immaḍi consecrated the temple of Gōpālasvāmin, raised a new pinnacle and celebrated the festival of the god for five days in Phālguna.

cells.location: Duvva
cells.place: On the pillar of Gōpālasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record grant for three twilight lamps by some mantri.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · GUNTUR DISTRICT. / SATTENAPALLE TALUK. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Munugodu—On a slab set up in a street of the village.
cells.remarks: States that a certain Agi-oṭṭi constructed a temple of Jina at Muṇuguḍu, in the time of the Mēru Surastha-Tīrtha and that Bōya-Gaṭṭa, a servant of king Goṅka, effected some repairs to it.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Muṇuguḍu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab set up in the place of Gōpālasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Registers gift of land to the Śīla-Jinālaya at Muṇuguḍu by Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Goṅkaya.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Muṇuguḍu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a third slab set up in the place of Gōpālasvāmin. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. States that a gift of land was made to the vandi called Prithvītilaka. Mentions a certain Billama-Nāyaka.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Cherlaguḍipāḍu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in a field about three miles to the south-east of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers grant of land to a Brāhmaṇ named Marambhaṭṭa by the grandson of Kurunāḍi Mallāra-yāmāru and son of Bēśaradinātha of the Vijjarlā-gōtra.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Piḷḷavayi — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up near the Śiva temple in the village.
cells.remarks: States that, while Gaṅgēya-Sāhini the faithful subordinate of the king was ruling the earth, a certain Uḷḷepalli Bāchi-Reḍḍi renovated the temple of Kālēśvara at Piḷḷa-vayi including the pinnacle and that the dēvasthāna-sthānāpati-mūla-purushas of the village built it made a gift of land to the temple, for the merit of her father Ammadēva and her husband Lakshmīdēva.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Pulipadu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone set up in front of the Āñjanēya temple in the village.
cells.date: Šaka 142[7], Raktakshi, Magha, śu. 11, Thursday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 22: Śaka 142[7], Raktākshi, Māgha, śu. 11, Thursday = A.D. 1505, January 16, Thursday; 40. The Śaka year was current.]
cells.remarks: States that the image of Hañumān was set up and a grant of land for offerings to it was made by a certain Chidurele-Ayyangāru, for the merit of his parents.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Pulipadu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in the place of Śiva... †
cells.remarks: Registers grant of land for offerings in the temple of Hanumān at Pulipāḍu by a certain Śinga-Paṇḍita, agent of the king, for the merit of his parents and for the merit of his master and of Vēlagūri Kāyapaṇēṅgāru who was governing the sīma.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Pulipadu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar set up in front of the Venugopalasvamin temple in the same village (as Śiva temple). †
cells.date: Šaka 1218, Durmukhi, Karttika, ba. 15, Sunday, solar eolipse.
cells.remarks: Records gift of an oil-mill for the lamps in the temple of Chenna-Gopinatha at Pulipadu, by a certain Būruvumadla Malnāyaningāru, for the merit of Gundaya-Nayaka and Māraya-Sāhini, the favourite servants of the king.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Pulipadu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone set up near Venugopalasvamin temple. †
cells.remarks: States that the marriage of the temple of Śrī-Gōpāḍayya was celebrated by the king and that for the merit of two persons who were evidently his servants.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Pulipadu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar set up in front of Venugopalasvamin temple. †
cells.remarks: Records construction of the prākāra, maṇḍapa, gōpura, the compound wall (ēru) and the durga-madhyam in the temple of the village by a certain Gōpāḍayya, a servant of the king, who was himself a descendant of Śrī-Moḍalēśvara of the family of Vīra-Nārāyaṇadāsa, for the merit of the king. Records also gift of land, tolls and oil-mill by the king's Mudaliyar, the king's agent.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Poḍḍa Garlapāḍu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone set up in front of the Sītārāmasvāmin temple in the village.
cells.remarks: States that the temple of Sītā-Rāma at Peḍḍa-Garlapāḍu which had been destroyed by Garipaṭi Sēshāchalam of Ikkallapāḍu had fallen into disuse on account of the famine in the year, Palguṇa, and that his sons Lakshmī-pati and Sūbba-Rāma reconstructed the temple, repaired the old images, consecrated them and obtained some lands as inām in the villages of Būḍavāḍa, Gōgulapāḍu and Peḍḍa-Garlapāḍu from the Palnāḍu Zamindar for their daily worship.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Podda Garlapadu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Venugopalasvamin temple in the same village (as Sitaramasvamin temple). †
cells.remarks: States that the shrine of Vēnugopalasvamin at 'edagarlapadu which had fallen into decay was recosecrated by a certain Kavalavāya Ramachandra who also made provision for offerings and worship in it by obtaining a grant of land from the Divāṇamtāru (Government).

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Podda Garlapadu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Ramalingasvamin temple in the same village (as Venugopalasvamin temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register gift of land for a feeding-house and a water-pandal.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Podda Garlapadu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of Ramalingasvamin temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Seems to register some grant made by Komma-Naymi[varu], son of Aruvelli Nārapa-Na[yanivāru]. a subordinate of the king.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Podda Garlapadu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab set up in front of Ramalingasvamin temple. †
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged. Seems to record gift of tolls for a lamp.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Podda Garlapadu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up by the side of the railway line in the same village (as Ramalingasvamin temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 1681, Pramā-thi, Śrāvaṇa, śu. 10, Friday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 32: Śaka 1681, Pramāthin, Śrāvaṇa, śu. 10, Friday = A.D. 1759, August 3, Friday; 64.]
cells.remarks: States that the boundaries of the village were marked and the Jayastambha was set up by Rangarāju, son of Garlapāḍu.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Daida — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in the Buggamallesvara temple in the same village (as Ramalingasvamin temple). †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Gives the name Sa[chi]manya-lo[ka]-vi-ma[l]i.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Pondgala — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in the Buggamallesvara temple in the same village (as Buggamallesvara temple). †
cells.remarks: States that in this year Krishṇarāya (the river Krishna) rose in floods up to the waist of the image of Āñjanēya at Kaṇḍanōlu-Koṭṭu.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in the Āñjanēya temple in the same village (as Buggamallesvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Records construction of the shrine of Jalpēsa by a certain Maindarāma and mentions the master architect Kalgārabharaṇachārya.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Pondgala † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar in the Bubbinayaka temple, four miles from the same village (as Buggamallesvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions god Jalpēśvara and Kaḷgabhāvana of the Viśvakarma-kula.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / SATTENAPALLE TALUK · Rāmapuram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone set up in front of the Vēṇugōpālasvāmin temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the shrine of Hanumantāya amby a certain Peḍḍi-Pāpayya, son of Nara[la]-Gōvindu.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · GUNTUR DISTRICT—cont. / PALNAD TALUK—cont. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar set up by the side of the tank in the same village (as Venugopalasvamin temple). †
cells.remarks: Modern. States that provision was made for the upkeep of the tank day by a certain Guruva-Reḍḍi and his wife Nāramma by their sons Veṅkaṭa-Reḍḍi and Kiōbha-Rāmu.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Gamalapāḍu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On three faces of the Nandi-pillar lying in front of the ruined Śambhu temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Do. .. Gives a list of the plots of land granted in various years to the temple of Śvayambhudėva of Ubbepalli by Kummarikundala Betarajn, Bhaskaradėva, Śamadėva and Jayapa-Nayaks.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · GAMALAPADU † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the pillar of Śambhu †
cells.remarks: Registers gift of land made by Dadi Šooha for the merit of Mallikarjuna-Nayaks, and gifts by some other persons for offerings to the same deity.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · GAMALAPADU † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up behind the Chenna-Keśava temple in the same village (as Śambhu temple). †
cells.remarks: Records gift of land for the merit of the temple of Rājagō[pā]la-svāmin at Gamalapāḍu and the conservation of the images of Narasimha and Garuḍa by a certain Gōlla-Narasimha, for the merit of his parents Gaṅgama and Channama.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · GAMALAPADU † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up behind the Chenna-Keśava temple in the same village (as Śambhu temple). †
cells.remarks: Records construction of the mukha-maṇḍapa of the temple of Chenna-Mallikarjuna by a certain Kākaḍi-Mādaya, for the merit of his parents Gaṅgama and Channama.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · GAMALAPADU † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the doorway of the Śiva temple called the Nāyakuraliguḍi in the same village (as Chenna-Keśava temple). †
cells.remarks: Records gift of land by a certain Gaṇḍaya-Reḍḍi for worship.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab in the same place.
cells.date: Šaka 1[2]34, Paridhavi, Phalguna, śu [1]2, [Friday]. [date-calculation appendix, No. 43: Śaka 1[2]34, Paribhāva, Phālguna, śu. [1] 2, [Friday] = A.D. 1313, February 9, Friday; 03.]
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers similar grant by Maharaya-Gajasahini Gu[yi]-Redđingaru for the merit of Keśāni-Ammaṅgaru and Rudradėvaniṅgaru. Mentions Gamalapadu.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Naḍikuḍu — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register grant of land in the village of Naḍikuḍi to the temple of Mudivēma-Mahādēva by Rudraḍēvi.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · NAḌIKŪḌU † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone set up in front of Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the formation of a village called Betapuri to the south of Nadukuđi on the bank of the river Krishna, and its grant as sarvamānya to the temple of Muktėsvara by a chief named Reobarla-Beta. Mentions king Rudra.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · NAḌIKŪḌU † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the wall of Śiva temple †
cells.remarks: States that a certain Gōlla Channama-rāju, son of Virappa, constructed the mukha-maṇḍapa and granted some land to the temple.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Dachepalle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone set up in front of the Nāgēśvara temple in the village.
cells.date: Śaka 1135, Śrī-mukha, Vaiśākha, ba. pañchamī, Thursday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 47: Śaka 1135, Srimukha, Vaisākha, ba. 5, Thursday Probably A.D. 1213, May 10, Friday; f.d.t.·71. Ba. 5 was not current on Thursday.]
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register grant of half of the village Dāchepalli to the temple of Muktēśvara by Vimala-Vikramāditya and Kāma-Nāyaka for the merit of their parents. Mentions a grant of land to a temple of a number of high-sounding birudas. Mentions Gaṇapati-dēva, perhaps the Kākatiya king of that name.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · DACHEPALLE † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in front of the ruined Śiva temple in the fort of Peḍḍakōṭa in the same village (as Nāgēśvara temple). †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Registers grant of dry and wet lands as sarvamānya and certain tolls. Mentions Ubbēpalli.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · DACHEPALLE † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying in front of the Aṅjanēya temple near the choultry in the same village (as Śiva temple). †
cells.remarks: Records construction of steps to the Naguvaru (stream) and the Subhāraya shrine, by a private individual.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Madinapadu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying by the side of the well called Padakamari-bhavi in the village.
cells.date: Śaka 1755, Nandana, Śrāvaṇa, śu 7, Sunday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 50: Śaka 1755, Nandana, Śrāvaṇa, śu. 7, Sunday. cells.remarks: States that this well which was in ruins was renovated by a certain Venkatachalam of the Potimamu family.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Regulagadda — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in front of the Gopālasvāmin temple in the village.
cells.date:
Śaka 1234, Pra-mādhōja, Māgha, śu 16, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 51: Śaka 1234, Pramādicha, Mā[gha], su. 15, Monday
= A.D. 1813, December 3, Monday; '80. There was a lunar eclipse on this day, but not quoted.]
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records construction of the temple of Prasanna-Vallabhadēva in the agrahāra village Kōkōlagadda, and grant of land for the village to it by the Mahājanas, etc. Mentions Krishnarāya.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Regulagadda † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab lying near Gopālasvāmin temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1(0)48[3], (mistake for 1483), Raudri, Chaitra, śu 5, Thursday.
cells.remarks: Records renovation of the temple of Kēśavarāya at Rēgulagada in Tangēḍu-sīma, which had been given to Pemmasāni Timma-Nāyanigāru and the grant of land for offerings to the deity. The Zudayūru Vēma-gāra mark is carved at the top.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Takkellapadu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone lying in a field in the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register a grant of land for daily worship (the name of the deity and the name lost) at Takkellapadu by a certain Kāñcugāri Sivarāyanigāru.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Takkellapadu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar in the Hanuman temple in the same village (as Gopālasvāmin temple). †
cells.remarks: States that the ruined Añjanēya temple and the Garuḍa-stambha in it were renovated by a certain [San]kara-Nāyaka.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Rāmalingasvāmin temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Records grants of lands made by [E]kāru, the pradhāni and gaṇadhipati of the king; and by Arivelli Talli-Nāyaka, for worship in the temple of Mallinātha at Takkellapadu.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Machavaram — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Rāmalingasvāmin temple in the same village (as Hanuman temple). †
cells.remarks: In modern characters. States that a certain Kottamaka-lak-hut, the daughter of Alukuri Kichobayaru, constructed a shrine at Machavaram for the images of Sītā, Rāma and Lakshmaṇa.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Piduguralla — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar in the Gōpālasvāmin temple in the village.
cells.date: Śaka 1472, Saumya, Śrāvaṇa, ba. 6, Wednesday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 57: Śaka 1472, Saumya, Śrāvaṇa, ba. 6, Wednesday = A.D. 1549 August 14, Wednesday; 52, The Śaka year was current.]
cells.remarks: Records the gift (of this pillar?) by a certain Chithoud-ayya, son of Singaraju of Piduguralla, to the temple of Gōpinātha.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Mallavolu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in a street in the village.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record construction of a well by a certain Mallavolu.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Guttikonda — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar of the Guttikonda-guha in front of the Lōkēś-varasvāmin temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Records remission of tax (dēya) by China-Vīra-Nāya-ningāru Jāhgamagāru on the lands that had been endowed for offerings in the temples of Lōkēśvara, Vīrēśvara and Mallēśvara at Guttikonda-Sīgura-konda in Tangēḍu-sīma, entered the town of the merit of father Vīrapa-Nāyaningāru.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Guttikonda † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar of the maṇḍapa in front of the Sītārāmasvāmin temple in the same village (as Lōkēś-varasvāmin temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 1749, Sarvajit, Bhadrapada, ba 1, Thursday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 60: Śaka 1749, Sarvajit, Bhādrapada, ba. 1, Thursday = A.D. 1827, September 6, Thursday; 51.]
cells.remarks: States that on this day Svayamīrakāśānanda-Avadhūtasvāmin, the disoiple of Sachohidanandātīta-Śīguru Digambaravadhūta-Nityānanda, entered the town of Guohyadri.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM · Guttikonda † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up at the entrance of a cavern in the same village (as Sītārāmasvāmin temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 1754, Khara, Jyēshṭha, ba. septam1, Saturday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 61: Śaka 1754, Khara, Jyeshtha, ba. saptami, Saturday = A.D. 1831, July 2, Saturday; 29. The Śaka year was current.]
cells.remarks: States that the image of Ōṅkārēśvara was set up in the cavern (bilagarbha) at Guttikonda on this day.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Damaged. cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Rāmalingasvāmin temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Seems to provide for worship in the temples of Keśava-Perumaĵ, Siddhaya and Hanuman āt Janapadu. Mentions Tangēda-sīma.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK / RAMAPURAM — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab set up in the same place.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALNAD TALUK · GUNTUR DISTRICT—cont. / PALNAD TALUK—cont. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Mandadi.—On a slab lying near the Hanumān temple outside the village.

Registers grant of the village Rāmāḍuke in the Nagatana-koṇḍa-sīma by Timmari-Nāyaka, son of Yallari-nāyaka, a subordinate of the king, for the merit of the king. The chief is said to have got the Nāgatanakoṇḍa-sīma as nāyankara from Krishṇarāya-Mahārāya, and the grant was made on the banks of the Krishṇaveni during a lunar eclipse in the presence of god Virūpākshadēva.

cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: States that the managing body of the temple agreed to maintain two lamps in the temple with the interest on 6 Nellūr-puḍumāḍai endowed by Kōvaṇḍai alias Vāṇadarāyaṉ of Pichchippākkam in Maṇavil-kōṭṭam, a district of Jayaṅgoṇḍaśōḷa-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: Chingleput District—cont., Tiruvallur Taluk—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records gift of gold by Śembūr Maṇināgaṉ Iḍarnikkimallaṉ alias Vāṇarāyaṉ on behalf of Śeṅgēṇimiṇḍaṉ-Śiyaṉ alias Śambuvarāyaṉ for sacred bath and decorations of the goddess Āḷuḍaiya-Nāchchiyār of the paḷḷi-aṟai (bed chamber) of the temple.

cells.location: Chingleput District—cont., Tiruvallur Taluk—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall

cells.location: Chingleput District—cont., Tiruvallur Taluk—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: States that on the representation of Tillaināyakaṉ Rājarājadēvar alias Villavarāyaṉ, the king ordered the remission of taxes on 95 vēli of land in Kaḍambattūr in Maṇavil-kōṭṭam in favour of the temple, for worship and other requirements.

cells.location: Chingleput District—cont., Tiruvallur Taluk—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Slightly erased at the end. Seems to state that the merchant communities of Nellūr, Nārāyaṇapuram, Ārkkāḍu, Mayilāppūr, Tiruvoṟṟiyūr, Pūndamali, Neḍumbiṟai, Damanagachchēri, Peruṅgaḷūr and Tiruniṟu acquired the village Kaivaṇḍūr in Īkkāṭṭu-kōṭṭam and gave it as a tax-free dēvadāna in favour of the temple of Tiruppāśūr for the construction of the wall called Daṇmadāvaḷavaṉ-tirumadil in it and left the village in charge of Madhurāntaka-Poṭṭappichchōḻaṉ alias Tammu-Siddharaiyar.

cells.location: Chingleput District—cont., Tiruvallur Taluk—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Registers gift of land by purchase made by a certain Vēmbaṉ, son of Veṭṭaṇḍai-Nambi, a merchant of Pūndamali in Puliyūr-kōṭṭam, for feeding pilgrims in the temple. cells.location: Chingleput District—cont., Tiruvallur Taluk—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers assignment of taxes for worship and repairs in the temple.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALMAD TALUK · Tiruppachchur † — Andhra Pradesh

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALMAD TALUK · Tiruppachchur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the west wall of Vachisvara temple. †

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALMAD TALUK · Tiruppachchur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the wall of Vachisvara †
cells.remarks: States that the temple agreed to make certain ornaments to the image of Paraimalai-Nachchiyār and to provide for offerings on the fifth day of the Vaigāśi festival and on the day of the festival of the deity, with the interest received from Sendali Tiruk-kaḷatti-Māṇikkam, a mid-servant of the temple.

cells.location: Chingleput District—cont., Tiruvallur Taluk—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Vachisvara †
cells.remarks: States that the Śivabrāhmaṇas agreed to burn a lamp with the interest of 32 cows made by Kali-śattan Mōdi-Aḍavallān alias Nandipāṇam of Siyāpāḍi in Naḍuvilmalai-Iḷattūr-nāḍu, a subdivision of Kūḍal-vaṭṭaṇa-kōṭṭam.

cells.location: Chingleput District—cont., Tiruvallur Taluk—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Vachisvara †
cells.remarks: States that the middle States that the Śivabrāhmaṇas agreed to arrange for worship thrice daily to the image of Purpiḍangonda-Nāyakar in the temple, with the money received by them from Paśupatidēvar and Vināyakadēvar, the Āndāra (dēvadāsi) of Tirunavukkaraiśu-maṭha.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALMAD TALUK · Tiruppachchur † — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction of ornaments, etc. Records gift of ornaments (named in detail) by Sirai-Nāyakan alias Aḷagiya-manavāḷa-dēvar of the temple, to the image of Ponnambalakūttan alias Pōrkōyil-Toṇḍamān of Mana-vil in Manavil-nāḍu, a subdivision of Jayangoṇḍachōḷa-maṇḍalam. cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALMAD TALUK · Tiruppachchur † — Andhra Pradesh

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALMAD TALUK · Tiruppachchur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the south wall of Vachisvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers gift of cows and a lamp-stand by a resident of Parameśvaramangalam in Sen-būr-kōṭṭam for a perpetual lamp in the temple.

cells.location: GUNTUR DISTRICT / PALMAD TALUK · Tiruppachchur † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the wall of Vachisvara †
cells.remarks: Built at the ends of lines. States that the temple received money from Kaṭṭaiyāvan Kaḍuvetti and agreed to conduct certain services in the temple on festival days.

cells.date: Śaka 1422, Raudri, Chittirai 4, Āśvati, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 169: Śaka 1422, Raudri, Chittirai 4, Aśwati, Monday = A.D. 1500, March 30, Monday; ‘59.]
cells.remarks: Records gift of land for offerings by Periya-Kuppayar and Siru-Kuppayar, sons of . . . of the village of Aḍanāṭṭa-pāḍi, for the temple of . . . Mahādēva at Mannivakkam. The village is referred to as the Nāyakatṭanam (gift for military service) of Goppayarayan, son of Bhujabala Bōppayarāya, the agent of Narasiṅga-Nāyaka, who was lord of the southern ocean, who was himself the agent of the king.

17 + 1st year, Kaṛkaṭaka, ba. shashṭhi, Monday, Rēvati. [date-calculation appendix, No. 189: 17th + 1st year, Karkaṭaka, ba. shashṭhi, Monday, Rēvati.

Begins with the introduction Tirumagal pōla, etc. Registers an assignment of tax-free land by the assembly of Tirumaṅgalam in Kaḷār-kūṟṟam, a subdivision of Rājēndra-śōḷa-vaḷanāḍu, to the temple of Paraśurāmēśvaram-uḍaiya-Nāyaṉār of Tirumaṅgalam, for offerings to the god Chandrachēkharadēva and for a twilight lamp (in the temple) in return for 20 kāśu received by the assembly. cells.remarks: Records similar order making a tax free gift of the village Kuḷumbalūr and containing other privileges to Tiruvālavāy- Sōmayāji for having renovated the temple from the upēna to the stūpi under the orders of Tirumalaṅkōlimāṇi Māvalivāṇādarāyar-iḷaiya-rājavēḷār-dēvar.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the village of ... and three plots of land at Pāḍirikkuḍi in Toṇḍaimāṇ-nāḍu granted by Kauṇḍadēva in the name of his younger brother Vaialāla- (Hoysaḷa)-dēva for the supply of flower-garlands to the temple.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of Āyḍal shrine. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. States that the several (merchants) of the 56 countries agreed to meet the expenses of worship to the image of Tiruvēṅgaḍam-Uḍaiyār at Appan-Tiruppatti, set up by Aṅgāḍiyār-Appan-Piḷḷai-Aiyangār from the rates collected by them on different articles of merchandise.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.remarks: Damaged. States that certain merchants agreed to provide for the daily offerings (of the image of) Tiruvēṅgaḍam- Uḍaiyār at Appan-Tiruppatti, the favourite resort of the god (Appan).

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.remarks: Registers assignment of taxes on (some lands in) two villages (names lost) for the daily offerings of the god Apan Uḍaiyār is taken to the shrine of Tiruvēṅgaḍam- Uḍaiyār at Appan-Tiruppatti.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.remarks: This is the sudāsēo-i of Alagurappan Tirumudiśattu-Nambi of Perungarunai a village belonging to the temple. The characters belong to the 14th century A. D.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the same Pāṇḍya
cells.remarks: Built in the middle. Registers tax-free gift by purchase of land by the assembly of the village of Alagar alias Tamilapallavarayan of Karkaiyur in Kuda-nadu for the expenses of the sacred bath, offerings and worship of Alagar and his consort in the Sundarapandyan-mandapa on the day of Vaikasi in the month of Ani, with a view to secure merit for his queen.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in Āyḍal shrine †
cells.remarks: States that the pillar was set up by Vilinai Parulōttama alias Śrī-Kulōttamadāsa of Kulōttunka-chaturvēdi-mangalam, a brahmadēya in Virādhāra-valanādu.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the Motta-krishnan-mandapa in Āyḍal shrine. †
cells.remarks: Slightly damaged in the middle. Registers an assignment of the inoome from the lands at Kamhavūr in Tuvarapati-nadu purchased by Rāmaya-Daṇanatha Sokkayan-[Dandanatha], a Sahavāsi Brahmana of Kaśmiradēsa, to three servants of the temple for supplying flower-garlands to it.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.remarks: Gives details of the boundaries of the lands mentioned above.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.remarks: Registers remission of taxes by the king in favour of the temple on some lands at Dēvimalai and [Valla]lavay for the daily worship of the image of Atkonda-vinnagar- Emberuman set up in it by Vāṇadarāyar Mahīpālar of Cēdiyar-kula, during the reign of the king, at Alagar.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of Āyḍal shrine. †
cells.remarks: Records that certain lands in five specified villages were purchased, separated from the nađu, made tax-free and granted in 222 shares to the 216 Brahmans of Kulasēkhara-chaturvedi-maṅgalam, to the temple of Alvār set up therein, and as vīritti.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of Āyḍal shrine. †
cells.remarks: Engraved in continuation of the previous inscription. Records a deed relating to the grant registered in No. 318 above, and states that the king was seated on the throne in the palace at Madurai, and in the tradition of [the king] in Uraiyur-kūṛṛam, a subdivision of [Pāṇḍya]nāḍu Rāja-gambīra-valanāḍu.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the mandapa in front of the kitchen in Āyḍal shrine. †
cells.remarks: States that for conducting worship, the temple remitted the taxes on the lands in Śiravellarai which were in the enjoyment of Alagiyamanavaja-Bhatṭa, the worshipping priest. Mention is made of the Chedirayan-piṭham and the Kulasēkharan-pundal in the Sundarapandiyan-mandapa, where the god was seated when the order was issued.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.date:
11th year, Vpiśehi-ka, śu, dvaduśi, Wednesday, Kevati. [date-calculation appendix, No. 321: 11th year, Vrischika, śu. dvādaśī, Wednesday, Rēvati
= A.D. 1313, October 31, Wednesday; '79; the nak. Rēvati was current throughout the day and ended at '01 of the next day. The record should belong to Jaṭāvarman Sundara-Pāṇḍya III.]
cells.remarks: Engraved in continuation of the previous inscription. Records retification by the king of the remission of taxes mentioned above. States also that Alagiyamanavala-Bhatṭa was performing worship in the temple of Tirukkōṭtiyūrtanda-Perumal at Samantanarayana-chaturvedi-maṅgalam founded by Pillai-Pallavaraiyan. Mentions the Kausikōtsava of the deity.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of Āyḍal shrine. †
cells.remarks: Records the order of the king making over to the shrine of Tirukkōṭtiyūrtanda-Perumal the rent due from the lands in three villages, which had been given in the 36th year (of his predecessor) to 32 Brahmans of the agrahāra Samantanarayana-chaturvedi-maṅgalam founded at Tirumaliruñjōhī-Tiruppati by Pallavaraiyar of Chakrapaninallur.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|xiv||176" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. XIV, No. 176</button>

filters.also: Also in another book we hold

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.remarks: Registers tax-free gift as śirupāḍikkāval of the village Perungaruṇai-chaturvēdimangalam, a brahmadēya in Sundarapāṇḍya-valanāḍu to Alagar-tirunīṭṭukkar, an officer of the temple, for the construction of the wall 'Kōdaṇḍarāman-tirumadil' built by order of the king, with effect from the month of Māśi in the 8th year.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: cont. MADURA TALUK—cont. Alagarkoyil—cont. On the same wall

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: cont. MADURA TALUK—cont. Alagarkoyil—cont. On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Seems to record some endowment to the temple of the god Alagar by the Kōṭṭaiyār Maḍhapa-Daṇṇāyaka alias Piṇḍaṇḍavillidāvar. At the top of the inscription is the word 'Jaṭāvarman'.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: cont. MADURA TALUK—cont. Alagarkoyil—cont. On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Fixes the rent due to the temple on certain lands which had been granted previously by King Vīra-Pāṇḍya as aḍukkalappuram (for service in the kitchen) to a certain Rāmānuja.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the left wall of the gōpura leading to the second prākāra of Āyḍal shrine. †
cells.remarks: Left engraved in the middle. Records remission of taxes on Maḍurāgalam in Pādirikkōḍi-parru, a subdivision of Teṇpāḍi-nāḍu granted to Alagar Siṅkkar for burning lamps in the Muṇaiyadaraiyan-tirumaṇḍapa and in the shrine of Sōma-Muḍaiyār in the temple of Tirumāliruṅjōlai, on behalf of Alagapperumāḷ Vīrappa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.date:
Śaka 146[6], [Krodhi], [Ma]kara, śu. paurṇami, Ārdra, [date-calculation appendix, No. 327: Śaka 14[66], [Krōdhi], [Ma]kara, śu. paurnamī, Ārdrā
= A.D. 1544, December 28, Sunday; f.d.t. '16; '25.]
cells.remarks: Incomplete and damaged. Mentions Nagayya-Nāyaka of the Achyuta-gōtra and his son Ellappa-Nāyaka.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.date:
Śaka 1466, [Kro-dhi], Kumbha, śu. ēkādaśi, Sunday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 328: Śaka 1466, [Krōdhi], Kumbha, śu. ekādaśī, Sunday
= A.D. 1545, February 22, Sunday; '41.]
cells.remarks: Portions left unengraved at the end. States that the trustees of the temple of the god Alagar agreed to supply oil for the daily lamp from the income of a village granted by Peddōṇḍa, son of Arigala Pariyappa-rāja of Uḍdagiri, as the ubhaya of his mother Vāma-yamma. The donor belonged to the Kaśyapa-gōtra and the Āpastamba-sūtra.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the right wall of the gōpura of Āyḍal. †
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Registers gift of land at Kāriyēri, by purchase, by a certain Viśaiyadēva of Vikkiramāśōlan-Maḍhiraṅgalam in Peravūr-nāḍu, a subdivision of Jayangoṇḍaśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu, to the temple of Alagar for expenses of oil for the image of god Alagar.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Āyḍal †
cells.date:
Śaka 1464, Śubha-kṛit, Mithuna 26, śu. prathama-ēkadaśi, Friday, Anuradha. [date-calculation appendix, No. 330: Śaka 1464, Subhakrit, Mithuna 26, śu. prathama-ekādaśī, Friday, Anurādhā
= A.D. 1542, June 23, Friday; '48; f.d.n. '27.]
cells.remarks: Registers gift of certain specified taxes due to the palace amounting to 1,200 paṇam to the temple of Alagar for offerings to the deity, for the merit of the king, queen Varadāraja-Amman and prince Chikkadēva-Mahārāya. The order was communicated by Vāraṇāśi Vāsaḍi, a minister, called here the 'kumāra' of Achyutarāya-Mahārāya.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · MADURA DISTRICT † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the right jamb of the door-way leading to the second prākāra, Āyḍal shrine. †
cells.remarks: States that this Toṇḍaimān-gōpura was the gift of Toṇḍaimān, son of Kaḷingarāyar of Seḷuvattūr.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Ramnad District. / Sattur Taluk. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Sattur.--On the north wall of the central shrine in the Veṅkaṭaramaṇasvāmin temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Built in at the beginnings of lines. Registers tax-free gift of land by the Nagarattār of Vāṇa[vanma]dēvi[puram] in Iruñjōnāḍu, a subdivision of Madhurāntaka-vaḷanāḍu in . . . . . Pāṇḍinādu to the temple. In characters of about the 13th century A.D.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Sattur † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Veṅkaṭaramasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Seems to record remission of taxes on lands made in favour of the temple to provide for offerings.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Erukkangudi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a rock a furlong to the west of the tank in the village.
cells.remarks: Records several acts of public good, such as digging of tanks, building of maṇḍapas, halls, etc. done by the chief Iruppaikkuḍi-Kiḻavan.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Erukkanguḍi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a rock in a field half a furlong to the south of the same tank.
cells.remarks: Records that Iruppaikkuḍi-Kiḻavan renewed the embankment with a stone basement and constructed a sluice to a tank which was thereafter known as Kiḻavanēri.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Erukkanguḍi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a rock half a furlong to the west of the same tank.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers grant of land for the merit of Siṅgama-Daṇṇāyaka by Tiruvaṇāḍayan and other members of his family.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Kundalakkuttu — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a rock a furlong to the north of the Perumāḷ temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Records gift of sheep to the temple of Mahādēva at Kūḍarkuḍi by a merchant of Vāṇavanmādēvipuram in I[ruñ]jōnāḍu, a subdivision of Rājarāja-Pāṇḍināḍu.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Kuṇḍalākutta † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another rock in the place of Perumal †
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Mentions Rājarāja-Pāṇḍināḍu and Madhurāntaka-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Kuṇḍalākutta † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a third rock in the place of Perumal †
cells.remarks: Incomplete and damaged at the end. Begins with the introduction [Tamil script], etc. Mentions Kūḍarkuḍi in Iruñjōnāḍu and Muḍikoṇḍaśōḻa-va[ḷanā]ḍu.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab buried in the eastern bank of Śirukuḷam canal half a mile to the west of the same village.
cells.remarks: Registers tax-free gift of land, to Muraṇaṉ Śāttan alias Karuntlakkuḍi-Nāḍāḻvān Peraiyan, a servant of Āḻaṅguḍi-Araiyan Ādichchan alias Aḻagiyapāṇḍiya Karuntlakkuḍi-Nāḍāḻvān, by the ūravar of Āḻaṅguḍi, for repairing the sluices of the tanks in Āḻaṅguḍi and Iruppaikkuḍi.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Kolavarpatti — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall to the left of the entrance into the central shrine of the Chokkanāthasvāmin temple in the village.
cells.date:
Śaka 153[1], Saumya, Tai 24, Sunday, Aśvati, saptamī. [date-calculation appendix, No. 341: Śaka 153[1], Saumya, Tai 24, Sunday, saptami, Aśvati
= A.D. 1610, January 21, Sunday ; '69 ; '33. The tithi was śu. 7.]
cells.remarks: States that the images of the god Chokkanātha and the goddess Aṅgayarkaṇṇammai were installed in the temple by Śevvandinātha-Piḷḷai Tiruvirundaperumāḷ-Piḷḷai.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Koḷavarpatti † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Chokkanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Records construction of the temple of Abhishēka-Chokkar at Kūḍarkuḍi.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Koḷavarpatti † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a tier of the north wall of Chokkanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers gift of lands in Kūḍarkuḍi alias Kolavārupaṭṭi and four other villages in Iruñjōḻa-vaḷanāḍu for meeting the expenses of offerings and worship to the images of Chokkanātha and Aṅgayarkaṇṇammai set up by Śēkkiḻār-Ariyanāyiṉār of Paḻuvūr in Toṇḍai-maṇḍalam, for the merit of king Jaṭilavarman alias Aḻagiyaśokka Varatuṅgarāma Vīra-Pāṇḍya, Veṅkaṭapatirāya, Viśvanātha-Nāyaka Muttuvīrappa-Nāyaka, Śevvandinātha-Piḷḷai and Tiruvirundaperumāḷ-Piḷḷai.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Panaiyadippatti — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a rock a furlong to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Registers gift of land in the village Paṉaiyaḍippaṭṭi by the king, for meeting the expenses of the abhishēka of the god Viśvanāthasvāmin at Madura, installed by Kumārasvāmi-Mudaliyār.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Veppilaippatti — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a granite pillar lying buried in front of the Gaṅgaiyammaṉkōyil in the village.
cells.remarks: Records that the dam was constructed by Ūruṇi Araiyan Madhurāntakan alias Karuntlakkuḍi-Nāḍāḻvān of Iruñjōnāḍu. See No. 340 above.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Sivalapperi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the mandapa in front of the central shrine of a lagar temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Records gift of cows for providing for five twilight lamps daily from the month of Masi in the temple of Kuberanatu at Ten-Tirunalinallur, by a certain Adittan Sadaiyan-udaiyan of Oda-vadu in Malai-mandalam.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Sivalapperi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Chokkanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Records gift of cows for two twilight lamps to the same temple by Kumaran Sadaiyan alias Satvanka-(Jata-vachaka)-Pallavarayan of Manarkarai in Malai-mandalam.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Sivalapperi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Chokkanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Records gift of a cow for a twilight lamp to the temple by Adittan Sadaiyan alias Sadaiyan-Nayanar of Manarkarai in Malai-mandalam.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT · Sivalapperi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Chokkanāthasvāmin †
cells.remarks: Records that the king begins with the introduction Samasta-jagadadhara, registers grant of land by the Nagarattar of Pūvankudi alias Varaguna-pandya-nagaram in Paya-taya-nadu, for providing for offerings and worship to the deity Varaguna-Iśvaram-udaiya-Nayanar of the village.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / NAMBURI TALUK · NAMBURI TALUK. Badhapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the mandapa in the Varaguna-Pandyisvara temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. Begins with the same introduction. Registers a grant of land by Sattan Peran alias Arjuna-Viranambi of Varaguna-pandya-nagaram for providing for offerings and worship to the deity Varaguna-Pandisvaram-udaiya-Nayanar set up by him in the temple. Pupattay-uddu is said to be a subdivision of Pāvudi-nādu.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / NAMBURI TALUK · NAMBURI TALUK. Badhapuram † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of Varaguna-Pandyisvara temple. †
cells.remarks: States that the Sivabrahmanas of the temple received sheep of Rajja-Vija-pala pura and arranged for the supply of one lamp and also for a gift to the presentation of 5 bull (bulls) to the temple of Kulottungasola-Iśvara.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / NAMBURI TALUK · NAMBURI TALUK. Badhapuram † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of Varaguna-Pandyisvara temple †
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Mentions Sri-Somanathadeva of Rajja-Vija-pala pura and [damaged].

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / NAMBURI TALUK · NAMBURI TALUK. Badhapuram † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of Varaguna-Pandyisvara temple †
cells.remarks: States that the Sivabrahmanas of the temple agreed to burn a twilight lamp daily in the temple from the interest on the money received by them from a certain Ferray Sattan alias [Suraka]-Muppudaiyan of Puvankudi.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / NAMBURI TALUK · NAMBURI TALUK. Badhapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of Varaguna-Pandyisvara temple †
cells.remarks: Registers grant of land for conducting the special worship called Kavirayan-sandhi, instituted in the name of the king in the temple of Varaguna-Iśvaram-udaiya-Nayanar, and his consort Rajarajasundari-Nachchiyar at Pusan-gudi alias Rajarajapuram of Manattalai-nadu of Muttattaga-nadu. The grant was made by the temple authorities in Kollam 724, Avani [20] by Ramappa Nayaka, the agent of the king, for conducting tirubali in the temple.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / NAMBURI TALUK · NAMBURI TALUK. Badhapuram † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Varaguna-Pandyisvara †
cells.date: Kollam 746, Vaigaśi 30, šu. Monday, shashṭhi, Puśam.
cells.remarks: Registers assignment of land by an agent of Nayinār-Mudaliyār, for forming gardens in Rāya-nyapuram, with the stipulation that the market-fees must be divided at the rates of 3 to 1 between the temples of Varaguṇa-Iśvaramuḍaiya-Nayinār and the image of the goddess.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / NAMBURI TALUK · NAMBURI TALUK. Badhapuram † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the walls of the Piḷḷaiyār shrine in the first prākāra of Varaguna-Pandyisvara temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers a grant to record provision made by a dancing girl for the deepa-ārādhanai ceremony before the image of the god.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / NAMBURI TALUK · NAMBURI TALUK. Badhapuram † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the left door-jamb of the eastern entrance of Piḷḷaiyār shrine. †
cells.date:
[Kollam] 967, Paṅguni 2[0], Thursday, sapta-mi, Mṛigaśiram, (Mṛigaśīrsha). [date-calculation appendix, No. 359: [Kollam] 967, Pānguni 2[0], Thursday, saptami, Mrigasirsha
= A.D. 1792, March 29, Thursday ; f.d.t. '02 ; '44.]
cells.remarks: Records the setting up of the jaya (dhvaja) stambham in front of the temple of Varaguṇapāṇḍya-Mahādēvar at Tar-Iśrai by Peṇyattiruvāḍi-Chakravarti who is called Rājēndran in another inscription, as a mark of his victory against the Pāṇḍya-dēva, the enemy of the temple. Gives the name of the śilpi as Nāmāśivāyan and of the poet who composed these verses as Moṭṭakkumārasvāmi.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / NAMBURI TALUK · NAMBURI TALUK. Badhapuram † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a stone set up in a street in the village.
cells.date:
Śaka [1520] Hēvijambi, Kollam [772], [Adi] 29, ba. daśami, Thursday, Kohini. [date-calculation appendix, No. 360: Śaka [1520], Hēvilambi, Kollam [772], [Ādi] 29, ba. daśami, Thursday, Rōhini.
= A.D. 1597, July 28, Thursday ; '63 ; '33.]
cells.remarks: Seems to record gift of money by Eḷambōdalaiyan, the agent of the king, and by the nāṭṭavar of Paṇakkuḍi, for the expense of worship and music in the temple of Vara-guṇapāṇḍya-Iśvara-uḍaiya-Nayinār at Pūśākuḍi alias Rājarājapuram in Muṭṭala-nāḍu.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / NAMBURI TALUK · NAMBURI TALUK. Badhapuram † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the Aḷagiya-maṇavāḷa-Perumāḷ temple in the same village (as Piḷḷaiyār shrine). †

cells.remarks: Damaged and stones lost. Begins with the introduction Pugalmāduviḷanga, etc. Seems to record gift of sheep (?) for a perpetual lamp in the temple by Chirrambalam-uḍaiyān of Puruḍaiyūr.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of Somanātha-svāmi temple. †
cells.dynasty: On the west wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Records gift of land and money for two lamps to the temple by the minister Manamatin.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of Somanātha-svāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged in the middle and stones lost in the end. Records provision made for a perpetual lamp to the temple at Rājarāja-chaturvēdimangalam, a brāhmaṇadēya of Kuḍu-nāḍu, a subdivision of Uttamaśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu in Rājarāja-Pāṇḍināḍu, by a native of Kāntiriyāḍi-maṅgalam, a brāhmaṇadēya in Sōḷa-maṇḍalam. Below this are two fragments, one dated in the reign of the same king, mentioning a servant (of his) by name Sōri-Taḷi of Kaḷattūr-nāḍu, a subdivision of Uttamaśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu in Rājarāja-Pāṇḍināḍu with the introduction [Śōḷar]kula-tilaka, etc.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place:
TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX—cont.
Attur—cont.
On the west wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Pṣaṅmoṇa Bīnabī, etc. Records gift of sheep and stands for two perpetual lamps to the temple of Sōmanathaśēya alias Ten-Tiruppūvanam-Udaiyār, by a certain Sīramaṇ Aditta-pidāraṇ alias Nujambadhiraṇ.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place:
TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX—cont.
Attur—cont.
On the west wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Seems to register sale of land by the ūravar of Korkai alias Madhurantakanallur in Kuṣa-nādu, a subdivision of Uttamaśōla-valaṇadu.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of Somanātha-svāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Bottom built in. Begins with the introduction Gṇumseī Gumse, etc. Registers gift of land as kuṇinṅga-dēvadāna for the expenses of the tiruchchennaṣai of the images of Olakka-Viṭankar and Nityasundara in the temple of Sōmanathadēva alias Ten-Tiruppūvanam-Udaiyār at Ārrūr, a brahmadēya in Kuṣa-nādu, a subdivision of Rajaraja-valaṇadu, by Bharadvajaṇ Madhava Udaiyadi-vakaraṇ of Kalitavamaṅgalam alias Sīvantalai, a brahmadēya in the same vāṇ, with himself as the tenant.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Slightly damaged and built in in the middle. Begins with the introduction Gṇumseī Gumseī, etc. Seems to register assignment of taxes by the king on the lands at Tirucchihrambaladēvanalītur in Korkai-nādu, for offerings to the deity.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of Somanātha-svāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Built in the middle. Begins with the introduction [Śōḷar]kula-tilaka, etc. Records gift of money for a perpetual lamp to the temple, by Lakṣmaṇan Nārāyaṇan alias Kaḷaraimāṇikka-p-piraiyan, the headman of Neḍuṅgari in Tāmarai-kula-chaturvēdimangalam, a brāhmaṇadēya in Tiruvāḍi-vaḷanāḍu.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of Somanātha-svāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Gṇumseī Gī, etc. Records gift of sheep for a perpetual lamp in the temple by Maṅgalankilaṇ Subrahmanyan Ponvilli, a resident of Aliñjiyamaṅgalam in Ala-nādu, a subdivision of Kshatriyaśikhāmani-valaṇadu in Sōla-maṇdalam. Kuṣa-nādu is stated to be a division of Rajaraja-maṇdalam.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Obtained by the Dakshiṇāmūrti shrine in the middle. The inscription portion records gift of an image of Triśūladēva to the temple, and the Tamil portion, of a perpetual lamp to the same temple by Sibgāṇḍi-a Pallava of Ārūr.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Tirumagal-pōla, etc. Records gift of sheep by Araṅgan Ārangan, the headman of Śīrūrpār in Kīḷār-kūrram, a subdivision of Nittavinōda-vaḷanāḍu in Śōḷa-maṇḍalam, for a perpetual lamp in the temple. Kūḍa-nāḍu is mentioned as situated in Rājarāja-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Ends of lines in the Latter portion built in. Begins with the introduction ത്രമണ്ണ് ലൂപ്പ്, etc. Seems to register sale of land made tax-free by the assembly of Kiranpur (for worship and offerings) to the images of Rajaraja-vinnagar-Pallikopārulinadēva (Vibhu), Durga-Bhagavati, Saptamātris, Kshētrapala and Ganapati, set up in the temple of Somanāthadēva alias Ten-Tiruppāvanam-Udaiyār at Ārūr-Sendamangalam. At the end of this inscription is another record dated in the 27th year of the king, which records gift of sheep for a perpetual lamp to the temple, by an archer of the king named Adhiran Sendil.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Records gift of buffaloes by a Vellāla of the village, for a perpetual lamp, to the same temple.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: States that the Sivabrahmanas of the temple agreed to provide for special offerings and worship to the god Somanāthadēva on the days of new-moon and to feed pilgrims on those days, with the interest on the endowment made by Udaiyadivakaran Trimūrti of Madēvi-mangalam, in Panaiyār-nādu, a subdivision of Kshatriyaśikhāmani-valanādu in Sole-maṇdalam.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Beginnings of lines built in. Seems to register a gift of land for providing for flower-garlands to the deity. Beneath this is another fragment of a record of a Chōḷa king (name lost) which seems to record provision made for daily offerings to an image in the temple.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Built in in the middle. Begins with the introduction ത്രമണ്ണ് ലൂപ്പ്, etc. Seems to state that the tirusvupṇā-ligaiyār agreed to provide for offerings (to the deity with the income) from the land endowed to the temple by purchase by the king's regiment called 'Arulmojidēva-terinda-parivārattār'. Beneath this is an incomplete inscription of the same king built in at the end.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Ends of lines built in. Records remission of taxes by the assembly and the tenants of the village on the land mentioned above which is stated to have been presented to the temple after purchase by the commander (Nāyaka) of the regiment 'Arulmoḷidēva-terinda-parivāra'.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUE TALUX · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in Somanātha-svāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the expression Svasti śrī, etc., of Vīrarājēndra which is followed by the regular introduction. Records gift of land, made tax-free, to the temple by seven persons of Kōrkai alias Madhurāntakanallūr in Kūḍa-nāḍu, a subdivision of Uttamaśōḷa-vaḷanāḍu, district of Rājarāja-pāṇḍināḍu.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another pillar in the same phase, Somanātha-svāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the introduction [pugal]mādu... Registers gift of land, tax-free, to the temple by two residents of the village, for lamps and for offerings to the deity on the day of Kārttigai.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the pillar of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction gīrāmātānātyām thumātānā yām, etc. Records gift of sheep and a lamp-stand for a perpetual lamp in the temple, by a certain Āndamaichchañi, a Brahman lady of Mummudisolochcheri in Rajurāja-chaturvēdimaṅgalam, a brahmadēya in Mullinādu. The same donor also made a gift of money for feeding pilgrims.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the antarāla of Somanātha-svāmi temple. †
cells.date:
Kollam 67[6], .. (date) 26, 8u. Wednesday, Hasta. [date-calculation appendix, No. 424: Kollam 67[6], . . . 26, śu..., Wednesday, Hasta
= A.D. 1501, June 23, Wednesday ; '53. The month was Āni and the tithi saptami or ashṭami.]
cells.remarks: Stone misplaced and lost. Seems to record provision made for offerings and evening worship and for conducting the śrībali in the temple.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the maṇḍapa in front of Somanātha-svāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers a tax-free gift of land as dēvadāna by Jayaṅgondaśolān Tillaivitañkan alias Kulasēkhara Kulapadarayan and three other persons, for offerings and worship to the image of Kshētrapala-Pillaiyar in the temple. Korkai is also called Madurōdayanallōr.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Registers tax-free gift of land to the temple by the assembly of Arror-Sendamaṅgalam alias Āvanipaśekhara-chaturvēdimaṅgalam.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction gīrāmānā mānā, etc. Records the order issued by the king while he was camping at Aljiyūr in Naṭtarrupōkku, remitting certain taxes with effect from the 5 + 1st year, at the request of his brother-in-law (machchaĵvi) Vikrama-Choladēva, on the lands granted after purchase to the temple, by Seyyānamudaiyān Kuṇrāmoli-Siṅgappirān alias Kurukulattaraiyar for the conduct of the service instituted in the temple in his name and for the expenses of the Āvani festival also instituted by him.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Engraved in continuation of the previous inscription. Records communication of the above order to the authorities of the temple.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Recorded assignment by the king of the taxes on 2 vēi of land at Varāndivayal alias Jayaṅgondapāṇdiyanallōr due from Sejuvattur-udaiyan Araiyan Tirunelveli-udaiyan alias Tōndaimānār of Tirukkaṇpper-kūrram, to the temple, at the request of Kalingarayan.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of Somanātha-svāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers the sale of land as tax-free dēvadāna by the ūrār of Attūr alias Alagiyapāṇḍyanallūr for the money endowed by Uyyavandāṉ alias Sembiyan Viḷippaṇiyāṉ of Kaḷḷakkudi alias Puṇyavarmallūr for the offerings to the god and goddess during the midnights service.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction புலீர் பேர்த்து, etc. Registers sale of land to the temple by the assembly and the tenants of Ārrur-Sendamangalam alias Avanipaśekharamaṅgalam, at the instance of Pil]lai Pañhavaṇ-Brahmādirajar who wanted to form a street named Tirumurai-seppēdu-kanda-porumaj-śirurilācīdi. See No. 435 below.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Records' order of the king remitting the poṇvari taxes except the salupattēvai (taxes on pearl fishery) due from the nāffār of Kuda-nādu. Mentions Vikramapandya-Nañjinadāyiṇan as a signatory.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Incomplete and portions unengraved. Begins with the Hoysala introduction: Samastabhuvanāśraya, etc. Seems to be a copy of a royal order, perhaps of the Hoysala king. Pōrēri, evidently mentioned in the above inscription. Mentions Kēśava-daṇḍanāyaka and śilāpaṭṭavai.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TINNEVELLY DISTRICT—cont. / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Records communication of the royal order mentioned in No. 432 to the nāffuvar of Kuda-nādu by Chēdirayar.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Built in at the end. Begins with the introduction புலீர் பேர்த்து, etc. Registers sale of land in Muduntlakkudi as tirumuñaiviliṅgam to the temple by the māhīsadha and tenants of Ārrur-Sendamangalam. alias Avanipaśekharamaṅgalam. Seems to be connected with No. 431 above.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Built in the middle. Begins with the same introduction. Registers a tax-free gift of land for worship to Rshētrapala-Pillaiyar by Trivikraman Śolai-Araiśu and Kāśyapan Sundarattoludaiyan Śoriyadēvaṇ.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar of the south verandah in the first prākāra of Somanātha-svāmi temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Begins with the introduction பூதலமடந்தை, etc. Records gift of a lamp-stand and sheep for a perpetual lamp to the temple, by a servant (agambudi) of Kanninaṭtaraiyar. Below this and in continuation is another damaged inscription recording gift of another lamp-stand to the tempe by a Brahman lady.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another pillar of the verandah of Somanātha-svāmi. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the same introduction. Seems to register grant of land by the temple authorities to a maid servant of the temple. Above this is an incomplete inscription in verse registering a tax-free gift of land for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Sōma at Ārai in Teg-Kuda-nādu by a certain Gangaikondān Tattuvaslaṇ of Ārai.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a third pillar of the verandah of Somanātha-svāmi. †
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged. Begins with the introduction. Registers a gift of land for a lamp. Mentions the gift of a grant of land made formerly for the maintenance of a śāntikkar in the temple. Mentions the hall called Ālagiyapāṇḍyan-maṇḍapam.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a fourth pillar of the verandah of Somanātha-svāmi. †
cells.remarks: Records the communication of the royal order to the authorities of the temple separating the village Gaṅgaikonda-nallūr from Śivanalūr, and assigning it to the temple as tax-free dēvadānam, except a fourth part of it which went to the king's treasury.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the pillar of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Records the same order as the royal order mentioned above.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT / TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK · TIRUCHCHENDUR TALUK † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the verandah of Somanātha-svāmi. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction விசேம திலையாச, etc., and after a few words, with பக்தமாது விசாச, etc. Registers sale of land made tax-free to the temple by the ūrt of Ārrur to provide for the waking-service of the deity. above this is another inscription with its beginning lost, which registers sale of land, made tax-free, to the temple by the assembly of Ārrur for the money endowed by Kanpuravaṇ Sankaradēvaṇ alias Velodikulantaka-Pallavaraiyan of Koluvanūr in Milalai-kurgam alias Gēyavinōda-vajanadu, to provide for the celebration of a festival in Chittirai.

cells.place:

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: cona

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the introduction பூமிமங்கை ஜயமகள், to registered gifts by the king, of land as jīvita for the maintenance of some maid-servants of the temple.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records oral order confirming the gift of 2 mā of land to Tirumēnipiriyadal, a maid-servant of the temple, for enacing a drama (tirunstakam) in the temple on one of the day of the festival in Āvani, from out of the lands endowed for the festival by Kungāmoli-Šingappirāṇ alias Kurukulattaraiyar of Seyyāṇam in Parakrama-t'āṇdyanallar in Mijalai-kūṇram. Connected with No. 427 above.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.date:
5 + 1st year, [Ku]m-rha, 14, [śu.] saptami, Wednesday, Anusha. [date-calculation appendix, No. 445: 5 + 1st year, [Simha] 14, [śu.] saptamī, Wednesday, Anusha
= A.D. 1255, August 11, Wednesday; 27; f.d.n. '10.]
cells.remarks: (Gives the details of the gift mentioned in No. 444 above, of which the assignment was made to the donee as kiḍaikkāśu by the temple authorities.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records communication of the royal order noticed in No. 444 above to the authorities of the temple.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: States that the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple agreed to provide for offerings to the images of Kuṭadāṇḍavar and Nāchchiyār set up in the temple by Aḻavāḷan Sovikaḷḷevāḷan alias Nāṟpatteṇṇāyiravan, with the money endowed by him, cāḍi-nūlu, with the interest on the money endowed by him.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of the same veranda.
cells.remarks: Ends of lines built in and stones out of order. Begins with the introduction pyrmala pirula, etc. Gives the details of certain lands sold to the temple by the assembly and the kūrāṇmai tenants of Ārṇur-Sendamaṅgalam, the taxes on the land being agreed to be paid by the latter.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Registers sale of land to the temple by the ūrār of Ārṇur.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the north veranda
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with the introduction pirula, etc. Registers sale of land made tar-free to the temple by a certain Araiyan-Ālyudaiyan alias Munaiyadaraiyāṇ, to provide for the conduct of a festival in Chittirai.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Slightly damaged. Records remission of some taxes, for the festival from the lands of the ūrār of Arror by the assembly of Kuḍa-nāḍu, on the land presented after purchaso in the 5+1st year of Vikrama Pāṇḍyadēva by Kuṟukalattanīyar, for the expenses of the service instituted in his name, and the celebration of a festival in the temple on the day of Makha in the month of Āvaṇi (mentioned in No. 427 above).

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of Somanātha-svāmi †
cells.remarks: Records order of the king remitting the taxes on certain lands in favour of the temple at the request of Kaḷiṅgarāyar, a high official of the king. The land was previously substituted in the name of the king, and for a special festival on the day of Śadaiyaṉ, his natal star.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the door-jamb of the Perumal shrine in the same varandah.
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end, Registers gift of land to the temple of Śīmārayana-vinnagar-Dēva at Śadangavīkurichchi, a brāhmaṇadāya in Kuda-nāḍu, after purchasing it from the assembly of the village, by Vikkiramakāma-Pallavaraiyan alias Dēvaṇaholai of Alagur[u]-nāḍu.

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a beam in front of Perumal shrine. †
cells.date:

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: TINNEVELLY DISTRICT— · Attur — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall (outside) of the prākāra of Perumal. †

cells.remarks: States that the village of Kākkānikkuṭṭai was renamed as Eṭṭamangalam-vayappuram and given by Naraiyūrkkaṇḍa Vāgiṇārāyaṇan Chinna-Nāyakkaraṇyar to Guhai-Īśvaramuḍaiyār at Vaṇṇāntuṟai for conducting a feeding charity.

cells.location: SALEM DISTRICT / NAMARKAL TALUK · SALEM DISTRICT, NAMAKKAL TALUK. Valappappaḍi † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to register remission of taxes on barbers.

cells.place: On the top of the wall of the central shrine of the Chenna-kēśava-temple on the hill.
cells.remarks: Much damaged and fragmentary. Mentions Chennataya.

cells.place: On a rock behind the temple of Chenna-kēśava †
cells.remarks: States that the images of the Dēvapratākas were presented by a certain Maiddāya, the agent of Nañjanāthayya, to the temple of Chennarāya-Perumāḷ at Śayādōrga called also Keṇṇatūru-durga which is said to have been constructed by a certain Kōṭṭi-nāyaka-Nāyaka.

cells.remarks: Records gift of gardens and waste lands to Veṅkaṭapati and Vēṅkaṭēśayyangar by a certain Chiṅgama-Nāyaka.

cells.place: Eḷikkurissimangalam - (Toḷkkumangalam) - On the west wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the Śiva temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Refers to a garden to the west of Maṅgāṭu. Contains an invocation to the deity for protection.

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / WALLUVANAD TALUK · MALABAR DISTRICT—cont. / WALLUVANAD TALUK —cont. — Kerala
cells.place: Kilikurissimangalam—cont.

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / WALLUVANAD TALUK — Kerala
cells.place: On the west wall of the prākāra (inside) of the same temple.
cells.remarks: States that the ruined temple was renovated by Vīra[kē]ra[larājēndra].

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / WALLUVANAD TALUK · Trikkangod — Kerala
cells.place: On a slab in the maṇḍapa of the Śiva temple in the village.
cells.remarks: States that the maṇḍapa was built of stone by a certain Iṭṭichchiri of Veḷḷaraikkāḍu.

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / WALLUVANAD TALUK · Perintalmanna — Kerala
cells.place: On a tomb-stone set up in front of the Travellers' Bungalow in the village.
cells.remarks: States that the tomb was erected by the Rāja of Wallowanad in memory of James Hart and Thomas Blake, two Privates of the 94th Regiment, who died fighting bravely against fanatic Moplahs (Maphalas) at Aṅgaddippooram.

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / WALLUVANAD TALUK · Alayakkad — Kerala
cells.place: On a stone to the right of the main entrance into the Narasiṁha temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Seems to record gift of money with which provision was to be made for the observance of the dvādaśī days in the temple at Kiḻachchēri.

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / WALLUVANAD TALUK · Mankada — Kerala
cells.place: On the base of the south wall of the ruined temple of Maṇiyōṭ in the village.
cells.remarks: States that the materials for the construction of the temple with its adjuncts were provided by Mamboṟṟe Irāmaṉ [Rā]maṉ of Viññakkaṭ-illam, and that the work was executed by Rāmmūr Nambu-Kumaraṉ.

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / WALLUVANAD TALUK · Kulattur — Kerala
cells.place: On a rock to the east of the old granary, beside a granite channel in the village.
cells.remarks: States that this (channel) was the work of Maññatta-Kaṭṭar.

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / CHIRAKKAL TALUK · CHIRAKKAL TALUK. Cherukunnu — Kerala
cells.place: On the lintel of the window in the east wall of the prākāra (outside) of the Annapūrṇēśvarī temple in the village.
cells.king: Ravivarma-Valiyarāja ... Kēraḷavarma-Valiyarāja †
cells.date: Kollam 1062, Mēsha 22 ... 1063, Karkaṭaka ... 1067, Makara 26 †
cells.remarks: States that this temple which belongs to the Chirakkal Palace was begun (to be rebuilt?) in Kollam 1062, Mēsha 22, by Ravivarma-Valiyarāja born in Aviṭṭam, and partly finished. It was continued by his descendant Kēraḷavarma-Valiyarāja born in Bharaṇī, in 1063, Karkaṭaka, and finally consecrated in 1067, Makara 26.

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / CHIRAKKAL TALUK · Elom — Kerala
cells.place: On the slab built into the side-wall of the tank in the prākāra of the Veḷḷāḷattu-ambalam at Kaḍanappaḷḷidēśam.
cells.remarks: States that the tank was dug (in this year).

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / CHIRAKKAL TALUK · Eramam — Kerala
cells.place: On a slab lying on the site of the ruined Chāḷappurattu-ambalam in the village.
cells.remarks: Records, in character of about the 11th century, an agreement (samayasaṅkēta) entered into in the premises of Chāḷaippuram (temple) among the Vaḷañjiyar, Nānādēyar and the servants (paṇimakkaḷ) about the remuneration to a temple-servant. Mentions Kaḍappapaḷḷi and Rājēndraśōḷa-samaiya-sēnāpati.

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / CHIRAKKAL TALUK · Kurrayattur — Kerala
cells.place: On a slab lying in the outer prākāra of the Pāvaṇṇūr Subrahmaṇya temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Seems to record gift of land for offerings and lamps in the temples of Tiruvayppāḍi-Tiruvaḍi and Pāgaṉūr-Tiruvaḍi from the Kumarakachchāṇam (Kumara-gadyāṇa) of the village.

cells.location: MALABAR DISTRICT / CHIRAKKAL TALUK · Velam — Kerala
cells.place: On two pieces of a broken slab lying in the prākāra of the Śiva temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Registers gift of land for offerings and worship to the deity and the appointment of men for service in the temple.

cells.place: On the slab set up by the side of the central shrine in the Adinatheśvara temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Begins with gift of land by ... śrīga-Marakara for the daily feeding of Brahmans in a Jaina temple at Adiyapadi. Mentions the dynasty of Adinatheśvara.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the second prākāra of the Sōmanāthēśvara temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions Vitharasa-Oḍeya as governing Mangaluru and Bānkurā-rājya under the orders of Saṁgama-Jinayaka-Oḍeya. Seems to record gift of land. Mentions the village Bānkurā.

cells.location: SOUTH KANARA DISTRICT · Ullāla — Karnataka
cells.place: On a slab set up in the ruined Hanumān temple in the ‘Old Fort’ in the village.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions Vitharasa-Oḍeya as governing Mangaluru and Bānkurā-rājya under the orders of Saṁgama-Jinayaka-Oḍeya. Seems to record gift of land. Mentions the village Bānkurā.

cells.date: Vijaya, [Mēṣṣ], 2[9]. Sunday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 530: Vijaya, [Mēsha] 26, Sunday Palaeographically, the record may be assigned to the 13th century. The given details correspond to A.D. 1293, April 19, Sunday.]
cells.remarks: Damaged. The characters of the record are of about the 13th century. (A.D.) States that this is the bammottiyakalis set up by the nādāvas and tenants. Refers to the sthāna-zatis of (the temple of) Lokēśvara at Posarala.

cells.location: SOUTH KANARA DISTRICT · Ulipadi — Karnataka
cells.place: On the sides of the śaligē in front of the Paḍu temple in the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Refers to the Hachchāradhirājya of a king (namo lost).

cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Śaṅkarēśvara temple in the village.

cells.date:
[Āṅg]irasa, Mēsha 12, Mandavāra [date-calculation appendix, No. 533: [Āṅgi]ras, Mēsha 12, Maṇḍavara (Saturday).

cells.place: On a slab in a field on the way to the ruined basti at Hosada, a quarter of the same village (as Sankesvara temple). †
cells.date: Śaka 12[7]3, Dur-mukhi. [Thātra-pa]ḍa, śu. 10, Sunday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 534: Śaka 12[7]8, Durmukhi, [Bhādrapa]da, śu. 10, Sunday = A.D. 1356, September 4, Sunday; 91.]
cells.remarks: Registers gift of land by Mahāpradbāna Mallaya-Dapnāyaka for conducting Rudra-pūjā in the temple of Gōkar-nīśvara-Māi kandēśvara thrice daily. The donor is said to have obtained the land from a certain Ajjaparasa. Mentions Baidūru.

cells.remarks: Registers gift of land and coconut garden at Baindūru by Mallaya-Dapnāyaka for feeding some Brahmans in the maṭha attached to the Narasīnhadēva temple. The land was left in charge of Viṭhala-Hebāruva of Neḍumane.
